issue.title: Replace support form with a compact shadcn signup composition
issue.description:
Replace the current "How can we help?" gallery composition with a compact signup form based on shadcn's official signup block.

Reference:

* Use the current official shadcn signup block as the implementation basis:
  [https://ui.shadcn.com/blocks/signup](<https://ui.shadcn.com/blocks/signup>)

Owner direction:

* Remove the existing "How can we help?" composition from the Cards gallery.
* Replace it in the same general gallery slot with a signup composition.
* Use the signup form portion of the referenced shadcn block.
* Do NOT include the large right-side illustration/graphic panel from the full-page block.
* Adapt the signup form so it works cleanly as a self-contained gallery card rather than a full-page auth layout.

Keep the core signup structure:

* "Create your account" heading
* supporting copy
* Email field
* Password field
* Confirm Password field
* concise helper text
* Create Account button
* "Or continue with" divider
* social auth buttons
* "Already have an account? Sign in" footer/link

Implementation basis:

* Reuse the official shadcn block structure/components as closely as practical.
* Prefer existing project primitives for Input, Button, Label/Field, Separator, etc.
* Keep the form token-driven and theme-responsive.
* Do not invent a parallel custom auth pattern when the shadcn block already provides the intended composition.

Gallery adaptation:

* Remove full-page wrappers, min-height behavior, and two-column page layout.
* Do not include the right-side decorative/media panel.
* Keep only the signup form card/surface.
* Fit the composition naturally within the accepted Cards gallery width and container behavior.
* Preserve stable geometry; form interactions should not materially change card height.

Interaction:

* Inputs, focus states, buttons, and links may remain lightweight and functional.
* No real authentication/network flow is required.
* Do not add validation flows that append large error regions or reshape the card.
* Keep interactions suitable for a design-system showcase.

Design-system constraints:

* Use Personal UI semantic colors and tokens.
* Use Heading / Body / Mono typography roles appropriately.
* Preserve light/dark mode.
* Avoid arbitrary raw colors when semantic tokens exist.
* Reuse shadcn primitives where available.
* Add no new public resource unless the official shadcn block genuinely requires a reusable primitive not yet present.

Gallery/layout constraints:

* Preserve the accepted container-responsive Cards gallery architecture.
* Keep the replacement in the intended support-form position unless another admitted ticket changes ordering.
* Preserve coherent DOM/focus order and responsive containment.

Acceptance:

* "How can we help?" no longer appears in the Cards gallery.
* A compact signup composition replaces it in the intended gallery slot.
* The composition uses the shadcn signup block as its structural basis.
* The right-side graphic/media panel is omitted.
* The signup form includes the expected heading, email/password fields, primary CTA, social-auth row, and sign-in footer.
* No full-page auth layout behavior leaks into the gallery.
* Styling remains token-driven and coherent in light/dark mode.
* Interaction remains lightweight and geometry-stable.
* No overflow, keyboard, focus, accessibility, or responsive regression.
* No unnecessary public component/resource expansion is introduced.
